proof_in_the_paper: The sub-angstrom spatial resolution and high sensitivity of incoherent scattering to atomic number associated with the HAADF-STEM imaging mode allows for efficient detection of even single Ni/Co atoms dispersed on or in the Al2O3 support. (21) The measured lattice spacing of Ni-Co particles was approximately 1.94 Å (see Figure 4D and Figure S13), which is slightly smaller than the standard value (2.04 Å) for the interplanar distance of face-centered cubic (fcc) Ni(111) and Co(111). This indicates that the postimpregnated Co is in a coherent substitution relationship with host Ni atoms, forming a Ni-Co solid solution alloy.
